description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git switch' command. It contains various test cases validating switch functionalities such as branch switching, creating, detaching, orphan branches, and worktree interactions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceding command fails.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specific file path is missing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output for equality.
